title: scikit-learn First Public Release
summary: The scikit-learn project history records 1 February 2010 as the date of its first public release, after leadership of the project passed in 2010 to Fabian Pedregosa, Gaël Varoquaux, Alexandre Gramfort, and Vincent Michel at INRIA.
significance: A project-maintained, day-precision first-public-release milestone for scikit-learn that is distinct from the project's earlier 2007 start as a Google Summer of Code project.

verification.note: The scikit-learn project's own historical documentation explicitly states that the first public release was made on February 1, 2010 and separately records that the project began in 2007 as a Google Summer of Code project. This candidate therefore records the first-public-release milestone only. It does not infer an invention date, system-birth date, development geography beyond the organization explicitly named in the source, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Two maintained versions of scikit-learn's official project history explicitly identify February 1, 2010 as the first public release date while distinguishing it from the project's earlier 2007 start.
